name: Neighbourhood Ecosystem Fund

funder.name: Carman Family Foundation and the Scottish Government's Nature Restoration Fund

summary: Development-stage grants for small, community-led groups in Scotland to design and plan local ecosystem restoration projects, with extra fundraising support for successful groups.

eligibility.rule: Income below £200,000 in the last year
Has a bank account in the organisation’s name with two signatories required for withdrawals
Project focuses on planning and development without physical delivery
Project finishes within 18 months of receiving funding
Has or will obtain any land permissions needed for the project
Local people are involved in planning the project

status.quote: You can apply to the Neighbourhood Ecosystem Fund at any time through our simple two-stage application process.

applicant_types.quote: To apply for this funding, you must be a not-for-profit community-led organisation based in a specific place in Scotland.

geography.quote: To apply for this funding, you must be a not-for-profit community-led organisation based in a specific place in Scotland.

access.quote: You can apply for this rolling programme at any time by submitting a short Expression of Interest Form.

window.quote: This fund is open on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: You can apply for up to £13,500 to pay for the activities of your project.

administered_by.quote: The Neighbourhood Ecosystem Fund is a multi-investor programme supported by the Carman Family Foundation, the Scottish Government's Nature Restoration Fund (managed by NatureScot), and other partners, and is managed by Inspiring Scotland.

effort.quote: You can apply for this rolling programme at any time by submitting a short Expression of Interest Form.
If selected, you will be asked to complete a full application form.
Applications will be looked over by a Steering Group.

eligibility.quote: Your organisation must have an income of less than £200,000 in the last year and its own bank account.

This bank account must be in the name of your group/organisation. Yes No 20. Please confirm you require two signatories to make withdrawals from your bank account. The bank account must require two signatories for withdrawals.
To apply for this funding, you must be a not-for-profit community-led organisation based in a specific place in Scotland.
Projects must focus on planning, not physical work.
Your project must finish within 18 months of getting the money.
You must have permissions to use the land for your project.
Local people must be involved in the planning of your project.
